comment: Filters of Films, Séries and Ta bibliothèque beyond genre, year and progress: Mira.Core LibraryFilters (CatalogQuery, Windows and Mac) and Jellyfin/Browse.swift (iPhone). queries: the choices (null = all) and Jellyfin's Items parameters they add, nothing else of these names (checked on Jellyfin 12.1: a file tagged « fre » and a « .fr.srt » beside another, stored « fra », both found; a region Jellyfin knows keeps its code in lower case, « .fr-CA.srt » stored « fr-ca », « .es-419.srt », « .zh-CN.srt », « .zh-TW.srt », « .zh-HK.srt », « .zh-Hans.srt », « .zh-Hant.srt » likewise; « .fr-FR.srt » or « .en-US.srt » are stored without a language; is4K, isHd and the languages match a series by its episodes). sort: each choice of « Trier par » for a list of types: « runtime » shortest first; a descending sort gives the title its own order, A → Z (Jellyfin gives the first order to every key it is not given one for: titles of a same year came Z → A); « played » of series = SeriesDatePlayed, their last episode played (a series has no play date of its own: on Jellyfin 10.9.11, 12.1 and 12.4, DatePlayed listed every series Z → A; SeriesDatePlayed with another key drops DatePlayed on 12.x, hence one or the other). languages: the server version and whether audio and subtitle languages are offered (Jellyfin 12 on; 10.11 ignores them).
